old: Bharadvaja's view begins (opening quote). avajñā-vadhaḥ: literally 'killing (on account) of contempt', i.e. putting to death those who are disrespectful; alternatively 'the destruction of contempt'. bhīta-manuṣyatā: literally 'the state of men being afraid'.
new: Bharadvaja's view begins (opening quote). avajñā-vadhaḥ read as 'destruction of contempt' (anger stops people despising the king; the counterpart of paribhava in 8.3.15); the alternative 'putting to death those who show contempt' is less direct. bhīta-manuṣyatā: literally 'the state of men being afraid'. The four nominatives are predicates of kopaḥ.
